reference_sculpt: Catalyst Game Labs Jenner from 2021 CAT35729, base 63
original_views: Four painted same-sculpt crops from Jaded Falconer: three registered, rear-right unscored
additional_views: Two unpainted actual miniature photos from RPG Mini Hunter: one registered front, one low-confidence oblique side excluded from numerical score
supplemental_digital_render: Promotional CAD-like sculpt render from eBay used only for shape cues, no photo score
photo_landmark_method: Hand-estimated silhouettes/landmarks from 500px image-query previews; source pixels not redistributed
registration_policy: One fit on v11 control for each photograph (perspective yaw/elevation/roll/distance/crop, independent left and right leg pose); freeze controls across all six passes

new_oblique_side.source_status: camera conflict and hidden far leg; diagnostic geometry cue only, unscored

comparison_warning: DO NOT interpret these metrics as absolute miniature accuracy. Different photo sets and approximate camera/pose annotation make improvements uncertain. The lower-confidence side view is explicitly excluded from acceptance.

validation.full_suite: Local full run exceeded available execution window; not claimed passed
